text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond continues to put in steady 
effort. However, she has yet to overcome 
the personal hurdle standing in her way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, with the Representative Exchange 
Race drawing near— <chrname> gallops with 
tremendous power across a severely 
deteriorated track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having watched the scene unfold, Satono 
Diamond requested that they go all out 
against each other in the upcoming 
Representative Exchange Race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to view <chrname> as a wall she had to 
overcome. Accepting those feelings, they 
promised to give each other everything 
they had.
